row:
This channel provides in-depth equine veterinary education for anyone passionate about horse health.

Expect case discussions, anatomy breakdowns, diagnostic reasoning, and practical guidance rooted in modern veterinary practice.

Perfect for vet students, equine professionals, and curious owners who want to understand the "why" behind equine care.

For colabs please email: markstroyd1@gmail.com
